title: A Sloth Can Hold Its Breath for 40 Minutes, Longer Than a Dolphin

scenes.text: A sloth can hold its breath for forty minutes.
That is longer than a dolphin can.
Underwater, a sloth slows its heart rate to save oxygen.
Its heart can slow by as much as half.
And it swims about three times faster than it moves on land.
The slowest mammal on land turns out to be an underwater athlete.
Forty minutes. Longer than a dolphin.

description:
A sloth can hold its breath for forty minutes.
By slowing its heart rate, it can stay underwater longer than a dolphin, and it swims about three times faster than it crawls.
What did you think sloths could not do?
